contract.summary: Update setup-display parameter handling so every raw parameter value is converted with pytest's existing saferepr helper before it is cached for display. This applies consistently to --setup-show, --setup-only, and --setup-plan and therefore to both SETUP and TEARDOWN lines. Raw bytes such as b'Hello World' must display as b'Hello World' without raising BytesWarning under Python's strict bytes-warning mode. Raw strings will consequently display with quotes, long representations will use saferepr's size bound, and objects with failing __repr__ methods must not crash setup display. Explicit IDs and callable/list-generated IDs must bypass saferepr and retain their existing verbatim display, such as FOO without quotes.
